newsitem.title: HUNGARY: EU HELPS HUNGARY, SLOVAKIA BUILD "BRIDGE OF PEACE".
newsitem.headline: EU HELPS HUNGARY, SLOVAKIA BUILD "BRIDGE OF PEACE".

text.p: The European Union (EU) has allocated five million Ecus for the reconstruction of a bridge between Hungary and Slovakia destroyed in World War Two, the European Commission's Delegation in Budapest said on Monday.
"At a place that for fifty years embodied the results of war and destruction, a Bridge of Peace will emerge," the Delegation said in a statement.

The Maria Valera Bridge over the Danube, named after a Habsburg princess, is the only war-damaged bridge not to have been rebuilt and would link the Hungarian city of Esztergom, once the country's medieval capital, with the Slovak town of Sturovo.

The reconstruction of the bridge would be an important symbol of improved relations between the two countries, who in 1995 signed a friendship treaty following years of strained relations over Slovakia's treatment of its 600,000-strong ethnic Hungarian minority.
The EU funds come from its Phare programme which supports the development of new democracies in the eastern part of Europe.
